claim: The answer/RCP J.2 coordinate of 1070 inches from J.5 requires the preserved 12-inch correction to equal the structural DWG coordinate of 1082 inches.
theorem:
def correctedGridInches (answerIn correctionIn : Nat) : Nat := answerIn + correctionIn

theorem mitStructuralGridPiecewiseCorrectionClosesJ2 :
  And (correctedGridInches 1070 12 = 1082)
    (And ((1082 : Nat) - 1070 = 12)
      ((12 : Nat) > 0)) :=
